title: p5-migration-chain-v1
purpose: PK-4 Stage C/D proof (PACK-6/PM3): a pack upgrade that skips an intermediate version must still replay that version's renamedFrom -- the guarantee the whole platform sells.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo -- proves PACK-6 (a multi-hop pack upgrade destroying data) is closed.
renamechain@1.0.0 -> @3.0.0 directly, never generating at @2.0.0. @2.0.0's chain entry renames Doc.code -> Doc.docCode; @3.0.0 adds an unrelated Doc.notes field.

The manifest id is shared with the sibling version on purpose (see p3-rename's own note): NPDev keys a file-backed H2 database's directory on this id, so v1 and the v3-direct-jump must resolve to the SAME database for the proof to measure anything.
expectedOutcomes: A row written with `code` under v1 is readable as `docCode` after regenerating straight to v3.
No row is lost and no value is blanked.
Deleting the 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0 chain entry and repeating the v3 regenerate REFUSES rather than silently dropping the column.
